title: Fortinet says 24 ransomware groups targeted Korea in January to October against 11 last year, per Newsis and Boannews
date_note: Newsis reports Fortinet presented the findings on 24 Nov 2026; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Newsis and Boannews report that Fortinet, at its AI cybersecurity summit in Seoul, counted 24 ransomware groups targeting Korea in January to October against 11 last year, and 43 organisations with disclosed attacks against 18. Boannews says Qilin was the most active group and manufacturing had the largest share of victims, at 24%. Fortinet's Kapil Gupta said, per Newsis, that attackers can now scale attacks much faster using AI.
plain: Fortinet says 24 ransomware groups targeted Korea in January to October, up from 11 last year, and 43 organisations had disclosed attacks, up from 18.
exec: Fortinet's leak-site analysis, as reported by Newsis and Boannews, shows more ransomware groups and more disclosed victims in Korea this year.

sources.name: Newsis: AI 업은 랜섬웨어, 韓 기업 공격 2배 폭증…제조업이 1순위 표적 됐다
Boannews: Fortinet AI Cybersecurity Summit APAC 2026

evidence.quote: 한국을 노린 랜섬웨어 그룹은 지난해 11개에서 올해 1~10월 24개로 2배 넘게 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다.
이 기간 피해 사실이 공개된 조직도 18곳에서 43곳으로 2.4배 늘었다.
킬린(Qilin)이 2년 연속 최다 활동 그룹으로 꼽혔고, 업종별로는 제조업 비중이 24%로 가장 높았다.

validation.note: Two independent publishers, Newsis and Boannews, each state the 24-versus-11 groups and 43-versus-18 organisations figures from Fortinet's presentation; Fortinet's own page not read.

review.note: duplicate merge: same Fortinet summit as groups event; merged Boannews source, added figures 24 vs 11 groups and 43 vs 18 orgs with evidence, validation now corroborated (Newsis + Boannews)
